# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Saturday, November 14, 2026

Morning edition for Saturday, 14 November 2026 (IST). Covers Friday 13 Nov and overnight. Stock and index closes are Friday's NSE files; markets are shut today.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Gold lenders pull back from short-tenure and EMI gold loans after Q2 slippage
The Economic Times reports that Bajaj Finance stopped short-tenure gold schemes in August and Manappuram is moving customers back to one-year loans, after borrowers used to bullet repayment fell behind on monthly-interest and EMI products launched under RBI's April 2026 gold-lending rules. Muthoot Finance's standalone Stage 2 rose to ₹23,467 crore at September-end from ₹1,876 crore in June, and Manappuram's gold Stage 2 went to about 5% from 0.95% in the quarter, per CNBC-TV18.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the whole listed peer set now says the same thing on the call: periodic-payment gold products slip into Stage 2 fast even when the gold cover is fine. Anyone reading Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 numbers will look first at how much of its gold book sits in monthly-interest or EMI products and what its Stage 2 did in the quarter.
Sources: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/satet-front/dodging-bullet-loans-hurt-gold-nbfcs/articleshow/135817183.cms) · [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/manappuram-finance-share-price-q2-result-reaction-asset-quality-gold-stage-2-loans-clsa-upgrade-buy-target-risks-20033253.htm)

### AGLOC cuts the 85% ceiling again, to ₹10,574 a gram for 14–16 Nov
AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 14–16 Nov is ₹10,574 a gram, down ₹146 from 13 Nov, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,440 (was ₹12,612). IBJA's 13 Nov PM rate for 999 gold was ₹1,35,809 per 10 g, and Reuters had spot gold at $3,879.71 an ounce on Friday afternoon in New York, down about 4.5% for the week, its worst week since early June.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the per-gram ceiling on fresh loans is now ₹439 below the 7–11 Nov level at 85%, and this one runs through Monday. Spot steadied on Friday, so the next AGLOC period will tell whether the cuts are over.
Sources: [AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/) · [IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/) · [Mint (Reuters)](https://www.livemint.com/market/ratehike-bets-keep-gold-on-track-for-worst-week-in-four-months-11794598496469.html)

### October retail inflation at 6.09% breaks RBI's upper band
MoSPI's release puts October CPI inflation at 6.09% (provisional), up from 5.54% in September, with food inflation at 8.94%; rural inflation was 6.63% and urban 5.41%. BusinessLine says it breaches RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit for the first time in two years, and economists expect a rate hike next month.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: another repo hike would feed into bank-loan and CP pricing; bank term loans alone were 39.69% of Muthoot Fincorp's borrowings in March 2026, per BusinessLine's reading of the DRHP. On Friday the 10-year G-sec yield rose six basis points to 7.31%, per Business Standard, and Manappuram's management said on its call that borrowing costs could rise 25–30 bp.
Sources: [MoSPI: CPI October 2026](https://www.mospi.gov.in/uploads/latestReleases/latest_release_1794478693814_7c90e80f-9e64-4aa4-b44a-1dc727b0fed9_Press_Release_of_CPI_for_October_2026_.pdf) · [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-13-november-2026/article71693403.ece) · [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/economy/news/rupee-weakens-to-94-25-10-year-bond-yield-rises-as-crude-prices-surge-126111301340_1.html) · [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/economy/cpi-retail-inflation-october-india-rbi-target-food-price-inflation-11794467724485.html) · [BusinessLine: Muthoot Fincorp funding mix](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/muthoot-fincorp-diversifies-funding-to-trim-borrowing-cost/article71695055.ece)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market


### Muthoot Microfin board to approve audited half-year accounts for Muthoot Fincorp's restated financials
Muthoot Microfin told NSE and BSE on 13 Nov that its board will meet on 19 Nov to approve audited financial statements for the half-years ended 30 September 2025 and 30 September 2026, "for the preparation of restated consolidated financial statements of the holding Company, Muthoot Fincorp Limited". Its trading window for designated persons is closed from 14 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: restated consolidated financials are the format an offer document carries, so this points to Muthoot Fincorp refreshing its IPO numbers to September 2026. The filing itself does not mention the IPO.
Sources: [NSE: Muthoot Microfin board intimation](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_13112026182612_PriorintimationBoardMeeting19112026SD.pdf) · [BSE: same filing](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/429c098d-df0f-4756-a000-feb2cff1ea74.pdf)

### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Gold-loan stocks fall over 3% as the market snaps a three-day rise
The Sensex fell 318.56 points to 81,592.45 and the Nifty 50 lost 0.61% to 25,144.30 on Friday after the CPI print, while Nifty Financial Services dropped 0.72% to 27,855.50. Manappuram closed at ₹308.00 (−3.73%), Shriram Finance at ₹970.00 (−3.37%, the Nifty's biggest loser), IIFL at ₹641.10 (−3.33%) and Muthoot Finance at ₹2,840.00 (−3.17%), while Bajaj Finance edged up to ₹1,117.00 (+0.18%); ET's provisional data show FIIs net bought ₹5,736.6 crore and DIIs net sold ₹2,253.6 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the gold lenders fell more than four times as much as the financials index, a day after the Manappuram print and the gold low. That's the market pricing gold-book stress and a rate hike together, and it's the mood Muthoot Fincorp's own Q2 numbers land in. The rupee closed at 94.25, 21 paise weaker.

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### No new NBFC instrument on 13 Nov; RBI fines Mobikwik ₹9 lakh
RBI issued no notification on 13 Nov. It imposed a ₹9 lakh penalty on One Mobikwik Systems for allowing PPI fund transfers to non-pre-registered beneficiaries beyond the limit and for late fraud reporting.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none directly; Mobikwik was penalised under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, not NBFC rules. The fraud-reporting timeline charge is the part any regulated entity can learn from.
Sources: [RBI press release](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63973)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

### Update: Manappuram falls nearly 4% the day after its Q2 despite a CLSA upgrade
Manappuram's shares fell nearly 4% on 13 Nov even as CLSA upgraded the stock to "outperform" with a ₹370 target, CNBC-TV18 reports; it closed at ₹308.00 on NSE. CNBC-TV18 says management guided gold-loan growth of 30% for FY27, yields of 17.5%–18.5% and RoA of 3.5%–4%, and expects the gold Stage 2 jump to normalise over the next two quarters.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the market sold the Stage 2 jump even with a broker upgrade, so asset quality, not growth, is what gold lenders are being priced on this month.
Sources: [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/manappuram-finance-share-price-q2-result-reaction-asset-quality-gold-stage-2-loans-clsa-upgrade-buy-target-risks-20033253.htm) · [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_13112026.csv)

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: infrastructure and project finance

No infrastructure-finance filing stood out on Friday, but the funding backdrop for long-tenor lenders moved. The 10-year G-sec yield rose six basis points to 7.31% and the rupee weakened to 94.25, per Business Standard, as Brent traded near $95.76 a barrel (BusinessLine) and October CPI came in at 6.09%. For infrastructure financiers that borrow long, higher term rates widen the gap between the cost of new bonds and older fixed-rate loans; the same move reaches gold lenders more slowly because their loans run under a year.

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Saturday, 14 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI, SEBI, IBBI or NHB instrument for NBFCs on 13 Nov. The one RBI enforcement item was a payments penalty, and today is the Reg 52 results deadline for listed-debt issuers.

### RBI fines One Mobikwik Systems ₹9 lakh over PPI transfers and fraud reporting
By an order dated 6 November 2026, RBI imposed a ₹9 lakh penalty on One Mobikwik Systems under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act for letting certain PPI holders transfer funds to non-pre-registered beneficiaries beyond the limit and for failing to report certain frauds on time. The inspection covered June 2025 to March 2026.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: not an NBFC rule. The fraud-reporting charge is a reminder that RBI checks reporting timelines line by line in inspections, a requirement that also applies to NBFCs' own fraud returns.
Sources: [RBI press release](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63973)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for NBFCs on 13 Nov
RBI's 13 Nov releases were the September balance of payments, scheduled banks' position as on 31 October, G-sec and T-bill auctions and a VRRR result; its notifications page still ends at the 11 Nov Domestic Money Transfer Directions. SEBI's items were recovery orders. IBBI's site says last updated 10 Nov, and NHB's latest posting is the 11 Nov RFP. FIU-IND was not checked in detail in this run.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no direct change. Today is the Reg 52 deadline for Q2 results; the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment deadline are the next dates.
Sources: [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) · [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0)

cards.title: Gold lenders pull back from short-tenure and EMI gold loans after Q2 slippage
cards.summary: The Economic Times reports that Bajaj Finance stopped short-tenure gold schemes in August and Manappuram is moving customers back to one-year loans, after borrowers used to bullet repayment fell behind on monthly-interest and EMI products launched under RBI's April 2026 gold-lending rules. Muthoot Finance's standalone Stage 2 rose to ₹23,467 crore at September-end from ₹1,876 crore in June, and Manappuram's gold Stage 2 went to about 5% from 0.95% in the quarter, per…
cards.impact: the whole listed peer set now says the same thing on the call: periodic-payment gold products slip into Stage 2 fast even when the gold cover is fine. Anyone reading Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 numbers will look first at how much of its gold book sits in monthly-interest or EMI products and what its Stage 2 did in the quarter.

cards.title: AGLOC cuts the 85% ceiling again, to ₹10,574 a gram for 14–16 Nov
cards.summary: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 14–16 Nov is ₹10,574 a gram, down ₹146 from 13 Nov, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,440 (was ₹12,612). IBJA's 13 Nov PM rate for 999 gold was ₹1,35,809 per 10 g, and Reuters had spot gold at $3,879.71 an ounce on Friday afternoon in New York, down about 4.5% for the week, its worst week since early June.
cards.impact: the per-gram ceiling on fresh loans is now ₹439 below the 7–11 Nov level at 85%, and this one runs through Monday. Spot steadied on Friday, so the next AGLOC period will tell whether the cuts are over.

cards.title: October retail inflation at 6.09% breaks RBI's upper band
cards.summary: MoSPI's release puts October CPI inflation at 6.09% (provisional), up from 5.54% in September, with food inflation at 8.94%; rural inflation was 6.63% and urban 5.41%. BusinessLine says it breaches RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit for the first time in two years, and economists expect a rate hike next month.
cards.impact: another repo hike would feed into bank-loan and CP pricing; bank term loans alone were 39.69% of Muthoot Fincorp's borrowings in March 2026, per BusinessLine's reading of the DRHP. On Friday the 10-year G-sec yield rose six basis points to 7.31%, per Business Standard, and Manappuram's management said on its call that borrowing costs could rise 25–30 bp.

cards.title: Muthoot Microfin board to approve audited half-year accounts for Muthoot Fincorp's restated financials
cards.summary: Muthoot Microfin told NSE and BSE on 13 Nov that its board will meet on 19 Nov to approve audited financial statements for the half-years ended 30 September 2025 and 30 September 2026, "for the preparation of restated consolidated financial statements of the holding Company, Muthoot Fincorp Limited". Its trading window for designated persons is closed from 14 Nov. Sources: NSE: Muthoot Microfin board intimation · BSE: same filing
cards.impact: restated consolidated financials are the format an offer document carries, so this points to Muthoot Fincorp refreshing its IPO numbers to September 2026. The filing itself does not mention the IPO.

cards.title: Gold-loan stocks fall over 3% as the market snaps a three-day rise
cards.summary: The Sensex fell 318.56 points to 81,592.45 and the Nifty 50 lost 0.61% to 25,144.30 on Friday after the CPI print, while Nifty Financial Services dropped 0.72% to 27,855.50. Manappuram closed at ₹308.00 (−3.73%), Shriram Finance at ₹970.00 (−3.37%, the Nifty's biggest loser), IIFL at ₹641.10 (−3.33%) and Muthoot Finance at ₹2,840.00 (−3.17%), while Bajaj Finance edged up to ₹1,117.00 (+0.18%); ET's provisional data show FIIs net bought ₹5,736.6 crore and DIIs net sold…
cards.impact: the gold lenders fell more than four times as much as the financials index, a day after the Manappuram print and the gold low. That's the market pricing gold-book stress and a rate hike together, and it's the mood Muthoot Fincorp's own Q2 numbers land in. The rupee closed at 94.25, 21 paise weaker.

cards.title: Manappuram falls nearly 4% the day after its Q2 despite a CLSA upgrade
cards.summary: Manappuram's shares fell nearly 4% on 13 Nov even as CLSA upgraded the stock to "outperform" with a ₹370 target, CNBC-TV18 reports; it closed at ₹308.00 on NSE. CNBC-TV18 says management guided gold-loan growth of 30% for FY27, yields of 17.5%–18.5% and RoA of 3.5%–4%, and expects the gold Stage 2 jump to normalise over the next two quarters.
cards.impact: the market sold the Stage 2 jump even with a broker upgrade, so asset quality, not growth, is what gold lenders are being priced on this month.

latest_circulars.title: RBI consolidates its Domestic Money Transfer Directions
latest_circulars.summary: RBI issued the Reserve Bank of India (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026, which consolidate the existing DMT instructions for banks and authorised payment system operators and take effect immediately. Cash pay-outs stay capped at ₹10,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month per beneficiary, and walk-in remitters can send up to ₹5,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month through BCs, with registration on a verified mobile number and a self-certified OVD.
latest_circulars.impact: not addressed to NBFCs; it applies to an NBFC only where it acts for a bank or payment operator. The velocity checks and alerts on unusual credit spurts in paras 15–17 describe controls also relevant to cash-heavy lending.

latest_circulars.title: RBI fines One Mobikwik Systems ₹9 lakh over PPI transfers and fraud reporting
latest_circulars.summary: By an order dated 6 November 2026, RBI imposed a ₹9 lakh penalty on One Mobikwik Systems under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act for letting certain PPI holders transfer funds to non-pre-registered beneficiaries beyond the limit and for failing to report certain frauds on time. The inspection covered June 2025 to March 2026.
latest_circulars.impact: not an NBFC rule. The fraud-reporting charge is a reminder that RBI checks reporting timelines line by line in inspections, a requirement that also applies to NBFCs' own fraud returns.

latest_circulars.title: Consolidation of Instructions Related to Priority Sector Lending – Drafts for Comments
latest_circulars.summary: RBI on 5 Nov placed five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions on its website — one each for commercial banks, small finance banks, local area banks, regional rural banks and urban co-operative banks — and invited comments by 26 Nov 2026. The drafts consolidate existing PSL targets and classification rules; ETBFSI reports they retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
latest_circulars.impact: no new NBFC Direction today, but the retained 5% on-lending cap is the ceiling that shapes how much PSL-eligible bank money can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel.
